summary: Top-up on kos-redraw-1. All 21 findings from the stale f4fa493 run were re-measured: 19 hold and 2 changed (the Dawn gold Buy now passes, leaving the danger button at 3.14:1; Goals' blank first paint is now about 0.3-0.6 s). None went away. The release's new surfaces (Badge Wall, the Seat as the Stage, Gold Shop, painted art slots, the Assistant redesign) add 25 new findings: 13 from the interrupted first top-up pass and 12 from this one. The main root causes are the same as before. Shared primitives undo the touch and 16px floors (base-layer rules lose to component rules). Status colours are tuned for the dark ground: Dawn and now the light shop themes inherit --red-soft and dark-ground scrims, so overdue dots reach 1.3:1 and text over the painted art 3:1. Dialogs are never tied to the route, so every drawer, sheet and set dialog stays open over the next page. There is still no document title, no haptics, no sound setting, and an inaccessible toast Undo. The new code is mostly careful (decorative art aria-hidden, reduced motion on the unlock overlay, named set panels, 100% visible focus on the Wall and Shop). Its slips are local: an unnamed compact showcase picker, dead Rotate thumbnails, a locked mode that rewrites the rule, double announcements, and a desktop preview shrunk to 28% on the iPhone.
coverage: Inventory and matrix are in audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/findings/a11y-hci.inventory.md. Measured with a11y-scan.js and a11y2-geo.js (names, touch size, ovals, contrast, 16px inputs, overflow, clipping, centring, tiny glyphs) over 24 routes at 1470x832, 820x1180 touch and 402x874 touch on the seeded account (a11y21-*.jsonl), plus the Wall/Seat/Shop/Avatar/Edit/Home routes on an empty account at mac and iphone (a11y21-empty-*.jsonl). The focus-visible sweep (a11y-focus.js) covered Wall, Showcase, Seat, Shop, Avatar and Edit. Screenshots were taken and inspected: Home (Graphite/Dawn/Washi Morning, mac and iphone), the drawer (Rotate and locked Your own), Calendar, Money (Dawn), the CS desk (Dawn), the Exams hero (Graphite/Dawn), Focus (iphone Dawn), the Badge set dialog, the Shop on iphone, the empty Wall and Edit seat on iphone, and the Assistant at ipadl. Contrast over painted art was sampled from pixels. Behaviour was exercised: every drawer mode with the config read back, Hide/Show/Voice focus, Wall routes, set dialog focus and arrows, Calendar Cancel margins, Goals load timing, Help marks, the Assistant chip sizes, and a dialog surviving 7 hash navigations. All 21 carried findings were re-measured or re-read (see recheck). NOT checked: the full tools/responsive_audit.mjs matrix (started; at ~400 cells it needed ~2 h on the shared slot tab, so it was stopped and replaced by the targeted scans); the unlock overlay triggered live (verified in code only); share-card finishes, notebook papers, pen sets and story covers (left for the Reports and ink areas); real VoiceOver and real iOS devices (headless Chrome only; the iOS zoom is inferred from computed font sizes).

findings.title: iPhone: most text fields and selects are under 16px, so iOS Safari zooms the page on every focus
findings.detail: Invariant 40 promises 16px inputs on the phone, and base.css sets input, select, textarea { font-size: max(16px, 1em) } under max-width 700px. That rule lives in @layer base, which the declared order (tokens, base, layout, components, views, themes) puts BELOW every component and view rule, so any class that sets a font size wins. Measured at 402x874: Assistant composer 14.5px, Reminders quick-add 14px, Focus topic/objective inputs 13.5px, Help search 13px, Files search 13.5px, Backup & Restore e-mail/password 13.5px, Routines settings times 13.5px, Media Sync inputs 13.5px, Assignments subtask input 13px, every .k-pill-select sort/filter (Assignments, Exams & Papers, Shrine, Wishlist, topic page reader select, Card stats retention) 12.5px, Pacing lesson-day selects 12px, vault score corners 14px. On the user's iPhone each of these zooms the viewport when tapped and leaves it zoomed (the layout then scrolls sideways until pinched back). Only the phone search sheet was special-cased (layout.css:457).
findings.evidence: css/base.css:156-160 (rule inside @layer base); css/tokens.css:35 (@layer tokens, base, layout, components, views, themes); overriding rules e.g. css/components.css:406 .k-input, :417 .k-pill-select font-size var(--fs-12-5), css/views/assistant.css:216 .k-asst-input font-size var(--fs-14-5); measurement audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-iphone.jsonl (font16 lists per view, script a11y-scan.js) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Re-measured at 402x874 on kos-redraw-1 (a11y21-iphone.jsonl): Assistant composer 14.5px, Focus topic/objective inputs 13.5px, Files search 13.5px, Shrine/Wishlist status selects 12.5px, Seasonal year select 12.5px; the new picture drawer's condition selects are .k-input--sm too (js/modules/artslot.js:69). css/base.css:156-160 still sits in @layer base.
findings.fix: Move the phone 16px rule to the last layer (themes, or an unlayered rule at the end of components.css) so it wins: @media (max-width:700px){ input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range]), select, textarea, [contenteditable] { font-size: max(16px, 1em) !important } } — or set --fs-input tokens that components read. Add a smoke check that no visible field computes under 16px at 402px.
findings.rootCause: Cascade-layer order: a base-layer guard cannot override component-layer declarations.

findings.title: Undo in toasts cannot be reached by keyboard or screen reader
findings.detail: The one Undo route for Daily Review triage (Tomorrow, Done, Study block) and Reminders' 'ticked in your plan' is a button inside #toast. #toast is aria-hidden="true" and the button is created with tabindex=-1, so it is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive tech; the announced sentence ('<title> · moved to tomorrow') never mentions Undo. The toast disappears after 8 s with no pause on hover/focus (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.2.1 Timing). A keyboard or VoiceOver user has no undo for these actions.
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:72-87 (tabindex '-1' at :76, 8000 ms timer :81, announce(msg) without the action); index.html:140 (#toast aria-hidden=true); callers js/modules/dayreview.js:534,615,621,622, js/modules/reminders.js:344 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Re-read js/core/ui.js:72-87 (tabindex -1, 8000 ms, announce(msg) only) and index.html:141 (#toast aria-hidden=true).
findings.fix: Give action toasts a focusable, named Undo: drop tabindex=-1 and aria-hidden on the action toast (or render action toasts in a non-hidden region), announce 'msg. Undo available (Ctrl/Cmd+Z)', pause the timer on hover/focus, and add a global Cmd/Ctrl+Z that runs the latest toast action.
findings.rootCause: #toast was made purely visual in Phase F; the later action variant reused it without restoring access.

findings.title: Focus chime is silent on iPhone/iPad and has no on/off or volume setting
findings.detail: The only sound in the app (Pomodoro cycle end, break end, stopwatch break nudge) is a Web Audio oscillator whose AudioContext is created lazily inside the timer tick, never from a user gesture and never resume()d. WebKit starts such a context 'suspended', so on the user's iPhone and iPad the chime never plays; the cue is then only a 2.6 s toast that a user away from the screen will miss. There is also no setting anywhere to turn the chime off, choose a sound or set its volume (grep finds no Sound/Chime control). Japanese voice lines and the Assistant's speech are the only other audio.
findings.evidence: js/modules/focus.js:788-801 (chime(): new AC() on first call from tick, no ctx.resume()); call sites :496, :508, :522 inside the interval tick; grep -rniE '"(Sound|Chime)' js/modules js/core → none | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): js/modules/focus.js:788-800 unchanged: AudioContext created lazily at chime time with no unlock on a gesture and no setting.
findings.fix: Create/resume the AudioContext in Start's click handler (unlock it), call ctx.resume() before each chime, and add a Focus setting 'Sound at cycle end' (on/off + volume, per device in state.ui). Also send a device notification for cycle end when the page is hidden.
findings.rootCause: Audio unlock rules of iOS WebKit not handled; no audio preference model.

findings.title: Status chips fail AA contrast app-wide (3.5–4.3:1 at 11.5px), worst in Atelier Dawn
findings.detail: Every .k-chip paints its text in the role colour on an 18% wash of the same colour. The wash darkens/lightens the ground towards the text, so the role colours that pass on the page (4.5–5.8:1, computed from the tokens) drop below 4.5:1 on their own chip. Measured on the seeded account (Mac, real theme via KOS.governor.setTheme): Dawn — Assignments 'Overdue' 3.68, vault 'In progress' 3.52–3.62, Wishlist '◆ Priority purchase' 3.36, '#urgent' 4.02, 'Medium' 4.04, '23 behind' 4.04, Governor '● All systems open' 3.96; Graphite — 'Overdue' 3.93, 'Coursework / NEA' 4.28, 'Not enough evidence' 3.94, 'recall 94%' 3.94, 'Too early to call' 3.94. These are the app's most decision-relevant labels (overdue, at risk) and are 11.5px, regular weight.
findings.evidence: css/components.css:191-199 (.k-chip: color var(--chip-c); background color-mix(var(--chip-c) 18%, transparent)); scan output audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-mac-dawn2.jsonl and a11y-mac.jsonl (script audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-scan.js); token ratios computed: Dawn --red on --s1 5.78, on its own wash 3.68 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Graphite, seeded, this build: k-chip 'Free' (Gold Shop) 3.94, '○ Not enough evidence' 3.94, goal.pace '◌ Too early to call' 3.94, 'In progress' 4.35, 'Gemini · auto' 4.28, '◆ Priority purchase' 4.23 (all 11.5px); Dawn Home day dot '5' 3.42 @14px.
findings.fix: Give chips an ink variant per role: text = oklch(from var(--chip-c) calc(l - 0.12) c h) in Dawn (calc(l + 0.08) in dark themes), or keep the role colour for a dot and set the label in --text-2. Add a smoke check that every [data-tone] chip ≥ 4.5:1 in Graphite and Dawn.
findings.rootCause: Chip ink is the same role token as its wash; tokens were tuned for page ground, not for the tinted chip.

findings.title: Touch-size floor is undone by shared primitives: pill selects 30px, switches 34x20, checkboxes 18x18 on iPad and iPhone
findings.detail: base.css gives every button/select/text input a 44px min-height under (pointer: coarse), but with zero specificity, and several SHARED primitives cancel or bypass it, so the same defect shows up on every page (other areas reported page instances; this is the common root cause). Measured on iPad (820x1180, touch) and iPhone: .k-pill-select 30px tall everywhere it is used (Assignments filters, Exams & Papers, Shrine/Wishlist/vault sort, topic reader select, Card stats); .k-switch 34x20 (Notifications ×5, Pen and ink ×4, Storage, Routines settings ×10, Focus 'Penalise tab-switches', Media Sync auto, Exams season/quiet); native checkboxes 18x18 (Pacing lesson ticks, Wishlist plan.check, tracker k-box, Files ink filter, Home habit tick input); the rail collapse toggle 24x24; scroller arrows 32x32; Reports Share/Export 32px; Card stats retention inputs 30px.
findings.evidence: css/base.css:115-121 (:where(...) floor; no input[type=checkbox], no .k-switch); css/components.css:417 (.k-pill-select { min-block-size: 0 } cancels it); css/components.css:207 (.k-switch fixed --fx-switch-w/h, not in the coarse block at :669-677); css/layout.css:233-235 (.k-rail-toggle at --hit-dense); measurements audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-ipad.jsonl, a11y-iphone.jsonl | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Under touch at 820x1180 and 402x874: switches still 34x20 on the new Avatar & profile page (gov.theme-follow, gov.art-on, gov.art-reduced), the Wall's List view, Focus penalty, Pen and ink, Exams; Seasonal year select 96x31; the Assistant's Pin/Hide/Voice chips 21px tall (see the Assistant finding).
findings.fix: In the components coarse block add: .k-pill-select { min-block-size: var(--hit-coarse) }; .k-switch { scale or an inset ::before hit area to 44x44 } (keep the visual 34x20 but pad the label/row); input[type=checkbox]:not(.k-switch) { inline-size/block-size 24px plus a 44px label hit area }; remove min-block-size:0 from .k-pill-select. A smoke check over every view at pointer:coarse for interactive boxes < 44px would stop the regressions.
findings.rootCause: The floor is a zero-specificity base rule; primitives set their own sizes after it.

findings.title: iPad portrait rail is seven bare kanji with no label, tooltip or due count
findings.detail: At 701-1080px (the user's iPad in portrait) the rail collapses to tiles: 灯 学 整 蒐 守 助 蔵. The English labels and the Study count (308 due) are visually hidden (clip), and there is no title attribute, so with no hover on iPad nothing ever names a tile; the only way to learn which kanji is Productivity vs Collection is to tap. The landscape iPad and Mac show labels and the 308 badge, so the same person sees two different navigations. Each tile's button is 30px wide.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/ipad-rail-crop.png; eval: rail items 30x44 at x=21 (820x1180, touch); markup 灯Home; css/layout.css:369-372 (#cols:not([data-rail=full]) .k-rail-label clipped) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Scan at 820x1180 touch: shell.rail-item 30x44 on every page; css/layout.css:369-372 unchanged.
findings.fix: Under the 701-1080 tier show a small label under each tile (as the phone tab bar is meant to) and keep a count dot on Study; widen the tiles to 44px. Alternatively keep the rail open (labels) on iPad portrait, which has the width.
findings.rootCause: Compact-rail rule shared with the 'beside the spine' desktop case.

findings.title: Backspace on any focused button navigates Back, even inside an open dialog, leaving the dialog over a different page
findings.detail: main.js treats a bare Backspace outside text fields as 'Back'. Keyboard users routinely have focus on a button (after clicking Cancel/Done/a rating, or tabbing), so a stray Backspace — e.g. meant to correct a field they thought was focused — leaves the page. The handler does not check for an open dialog: reproduced on the Calendar's New event modal with focus on Cancel; Backspace changed the route #/calendar → #/home and the modal stayed open, kicker 'Calendar', floating over Home. Browsers removed Backspace-as-Back for exactly this data-loss reason; Help & Guide does not list it (it lists Alt ← / →).
findings.evidence: js/main.js:20-29 (keydown: !typing && key === 'Backspace' → KOS.back(), no dialog/overlay check); repro via eval: before '#/calendar', after '#/home', dialogStill true; shots/a11y-hci/backspace-under-dialog-mac.png; js/modules/help.js:299 shortcut list | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): js/main.js:24 unchanged (Backspace outside inputs = Back, no dialog check). The general case (any navigation leaves a dialog open) is now its own finding.
findings.fix: Drop the bare Backspace binding (keep Alt+←/→ and the buttons), or at least ignore it when a [role=dialog][aria-modal=true], the Focus overlay, a review sheet or the Exam Room is open and when focus is inside #main controls.
findings.rootCause: Global shortcut written before dialogs were overlays rendered outside the router's control.

findings.title: The document title never changes: every page is 'Kurenai OS — Study Atelier'
findings.detail: No view sets document.title; only Focus writes it (the countdown, then back to the default). So the browser tab, the history list (long-press Back, Mac History menu), Mac window/tab switcher, bookmarks, and screen-reader page announcements all read the same name on Home, a topic, Money or a vault (WCAG 2.4.2 Page Titled). The router already knows the view and its label (KOS.currentNav), and the phone title bar computes the page title.
findings.evidence: index.html:6; grep document.title → only js/modules/focus.js:1070,1488; eval on 9 routes: title='Kurenai OS — Study Atelier' for all | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Only js/modules/focus.js:1072 and :1494 set document.title; no view (Wall, Seat, Shop included) sets one.
findings.fix: In router.js after each KOS.show, set document.title = '<page h1 or nav label> · <section> — KurenaiOS' (topic: '<ref> <title> · CS'); Focus keeps prefixing the remaining time.
findings.rootCause: Single-page shell with no title owner.

findings.title: Edit your seat throws away unsaved changes on any navigation, with no prompt
findings.detail: On #/governor/edit, picking showcase badges, a background, a title or a sigil marks Save as lit (dirty()), but leaving by the rail, Back, Backspace, the bell or search discards the draft silently. There is no leave guard anywhere in the router (no beforeLeave / canLeave hook), so the only protection is remembering to press Save. CLAUDE.md lists the 'leave-with-changes prompt' as not built; this records the user-visible effect.
findings.evidence: js/modules/governor-ui.js:658-680 (draft, dirty(), Discard → KOS.show('governor')); grep leaveGuard|beforeLeave|canLeave js/core/router.js js/core/ui.js js/main.js → none; CLAUDE.md 'not built from design turn 35: ... Edit seat's leave-with-changes prompt'
findings.fix: Add a small router hook (KOS.router.guard(fn)) that a view can set while dirty; on navigation ask 'Leave without saving? Keep editing / Discard' (Cancel-first, invariant 49), and clear it on Save/Discard.
findings.rootCause: No navigation-guard primitive exists; the editor keeps its draft in a closure.

findings.title: Buy in the Gold Shop spends gold on one tap with no confirm and no undo
findings.detail: A ware card's 'Buy' (and the preview sheet's) calls KOS.governor.buy immediately: items up to tens of thousands of gold are spent on a single tap, which on iPad/iPhone sits beside 'Try on' in the same 44px row. There is no confirm and the toast 'Bought X. N left.' has no Undo, so a mis-tap costs days of study gold irreversibly (gold is earned only by study).
findings.evidence: js/modules/governor-ui.js:1043-1044 (Buy onclick: buyWare(it)), :893-904 (buyWare: KOS.governor.buy then toast, no action); shots/a11y-hci/t-shop-mac.png
findings.fix: Either a short confirm for items over a threshold ('Buy Celestial Duality for ◈ 9,000? You will have ◈ 3,476 left.' Cancel first) or an 8-second Undo in the toast that refunds through KOS.governor (one refund path).
findings.rootCause: buyWare treats a purchase as a plain toggle.

findings.title: The Wall's tabs and set links have no URL: #/achievements/recent, /titles, /showcase and /set/<id> all open Sets
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md documents #/achievements[/sets|recent|showcase|titles|set/<id>], and the view parses its arg (achievements.js:110-113), but js/core/router.js has no ENCODE/DECODE entry for 'achievements'. So KOS.show('achievements','titles') writes '#/achievements', a reload or a shared link to #/achievements/titles or #/achievements/set/streaks opens Sets with no dialog, and Back from a set dialog opened by 'View on the Wall' does not return to the tab you were on. Every tab switch is also not a history entry the way the Governor's tabs are.
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.show('achievements','titles') → location.hash '#/achievements'; KOS.show('achievements','set/streaks/x') → '#/achievements'; location.hash='#/achievements/set/streaks' → after 20 s no .k-dialog, page data-page='sets'; js/core/router.js:45-50 (ENCODE: governor yes, achievements absent), :122 (DECODE governor), :172-177 (no decoder → arg undefined); js/modules/achievements.js:110-113,134
findings.fix: Add achievements to ENCODE ([tab] or ['set', id, badge]) and DECODE (p.join('/')) like governor, and replace the entry when the set dialog closes.
findings.rootCause: The view was added with an argument but not registered in the router's route table.

findings.title: The Wall, the Seat's showcase and Edit your seat wait 7-12 s on a dense account because every open re-measures all 254 badges
findings.detail: KOS.achievements.list() measures every badge afresh on each call (no cache between the boot/30-minute sweep and the pages). On the seeded account (1,880 media rows) one call took 6.9-7.9 s, the Collection set alone 5.1 s; the Wall body shows 'Reading your records…' for 12.5 s after navigation, the Seat's arc stays six empty rings with no label for ~12.9 s and Edit your seat says 'Reading your badges…'. Measured on a loaded machine (load average ~7.3 from parallel audit slots), so absolute times on the M4 will be lower, but the work is the same on every visit and on every phone tab switch.
findings.evidence: eval timings: list() 7867/920/7452 ms; per set: collection 5127, exams 1473, mind 1158, study 983, ALL 6954 ms; Wall body ready 12512 ms; Seat note after 12867 ms; js/core/achievements.js:329-341 (list → measureOne per DEF each call); shots/a11y-hci/t-wall-iphone.png ('Reading your records…'), t-seat-ipad.png (empty arc)
findings.fix: Cache the last sweep's views (value, p, tier) keyed by domain and invalidate on touch(domains); list() returns the cache at once and refreshes in the background. Make the Collection measures read counts from the media index instead of scanning rows.
findings.rootCause: list() and evaluate() share measureOne with no memo; Collection badges scan the vault.

findings.title: iPhone: the Seat's empty showcase draws six squashed ovals until (or unless) its note arrives
findings.detail: At 402px the arc becomes a nowrap flex row of six 44px slots plus the note div (flex-basis 100%). While the note is empty — the ~8-12 s before list() answers, and permanently when no badge is earned or near (a new account) — the note takes the row and the six empty slots shrink to ~26x50 ovals. Only once the note has text does :has(.k-gv-arc-note:not(:empty)) turn on wrapping and the rings become 44x44 circles.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/t-seat-iphone.png (six ovals under the XP bar); eval after the note loaded: slots 44x44, .k-gv-arc display flex height 92; css/views/governor.css:518-523 (flex, no wrap until :has(note:not(:empty)), slot without flex: none)
findings.fix: Give .k-gv-arc-slot flex: none and wrap the row always (or keep the note out of the flex row), so empty rings stay circles.
findings.rootCause: Flex items shrink by default; wrap depends on the async note.

findings.title: A badge set dialog opens over whatever page you moved to, seconds after leaving the Wall
findings.detail: KOS.show('achievements', 'set/<id>/<badge>') — what the unlock overlay's 'View on the Wall' and a ping click do — renders the Wall and opens the set dialog only when list() answers (8-12 s on a dense account). If you leave in the meantime, the stale callback still runs: its guard `if (!body.isConnected && body.parentNode == null) return;` passes because the detached body still has its root as parent, so the Wall is drawn into a detached node and openSetDialog() appends a modal over the new page (Money in the repro), stealing focus.
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.show('achievements','set/focus'); after 1 s KOS.show('money') → .k-ach-dlg 'Focus' appeared over #/money 8022 ms later; shots/a11y-hci/t-setdlg-over-money-mac.png; js/modules/achievements.js:126-135 (guard and openSetDialog in the async callback), :647 and :715 (callers)
findings.fix: Guard on body.isConnected alone (or a render token compared with KOS.current) before drawing and before openSetDialog.
findings.rootCause: Wrong staleness test in the async list() callback.

findings.title: Atelier Dawn: title plaques put gold names on pastel washes (~2.3:1) and grey 11px 'LOCKED · …' lines (~2:1)
findings.detail: On the Wall's Titles tab in Atelier Dawn, an unlocked plaque's name is --gold oklch(0.505 0.11 85) at 22px italic over the set-hue wash (oklch(0.71 0.08 173) at its ends, 20% ground in the middle over a photo) — about 2.3:1, not large text. Locked plaques print the name at 70% and 'LOCKED · KEPT GOING III' at 60% of --text, 11px mono with 0.08em tracking, over a greyscale photo lightened to the Dawn ground — about 2:1. The big plaque in the detail column repeats the gold-on-teal name. The scanner cannot see it (the photo is an ), so this was computed from the tokens and checked by eye.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/t-titles2-mac.png (Dawn, 1470x832); eval computed styles: on-name oklch(0.505 0.11 85) 22px, off-name oklch(0.235 0.014 55 / 0.7) 20px, lock oklch(0.235 0.014 55 / 0.6) 11px, wash linear-gradient(oklch(0.7075 0.0806 173.5) … oklch(0.955 0.008 80 / 0.2) 50% …); css/views/achievements.css:177-190
findings.fix: In Dawn give plaque text a solid scrim (a ground-coloured band behind the name) or use --text for names with the gold as an underline/rule; raise the lock line to --text-2 at 12px without opacity.
findings.rootCause: Plaque colours tuned on Graphite's dark ground; Dawn restates neither the wash nor the text.

findings.title: Edit your seat's showcase picker is 21 unnamed buttons
findings.detail: On #/governor/edit (Showcase tab, the compact picker) every earned badge is a <button> holding only a decorative medal (aria-hidden) and no text, so VoiceOver/keyboard users hear 'button' 21 times with no badge name; only the full Showcase page (opts.small false) adds the name span. aria-pressed is set, so the state is spoken but not what it is.
findings.evidence: Scan at 1470x832 seeded: governor/edit unnamedN=21 'ach.pick-item<button>' (audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y21-mac.jsonl); js/modules/achievements.js:402-404 (opts.small ? null : the name span; medal decorative:true)
findings.fix: Give each pick button aria-label: badgeName(v) + tier (and keep aria-pressed), or render the name visually-hidden when small.
findings.rootCause: The compact variant drops the only text child without adding an aria-label.

findings.title: Looking at 'Your own' in the picture drawer replaces the slot's picture rule while it is locked
findings.detail: Tapping the 'Your own' segment saves mode 'own' immediately (save({mode:'own'})) before checking the unlock. Without the 3,000-gold unlock the drawer then shows the lock card, but the rule is already written and synced: a Home hero set to One picture → Summer silently changes to the default (Autumn) the moment the user looks at the price, and stays so after closing the drawer. Reproduced: cfg {mode:'one',pick:'...summer'} → after tapping Your own {mode:'own',...}; KOS.art.pick('home') summer → autumn.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-drawer-own-locked-mac.png; eval in audit (afterOne / afterOwn / pickNow); js/modules/artslot.js:47-50 (save before canUpload) and :64-71; js/core/art.js:121 (own without unlock -> default)
findings.fix: Only save mode 'own' once a picture is uploaded (or the unlock is owned); while locked, show the lock card as a preview without writing the rule.
findings.rootCause: Mode selection writes state on every tap; the lock is checked only when painting.

findings.title: Atelier Dawn: Home hero's XP and HP line sits at ~3:1 over the painted art
findings.detail: In Dawn the Home hero's '2398 XP to 54' (muted, 12px mono) and 'HP 64 / 100 · Healthy' (teal, 12px) are drawn over the light painted season picture where the left-to-right scrim has thinned (42-62% across), so the background behind them is the art at ~0.5 relative luminance. Sampled from the screenshot: XP 3.2:1, HP 3.0:1 (AA needs 4.5:1 at 12px). The level bar's track is ~1.15:1 against the art, so the bar reads as a short black stub. In Graphite the same line is 5.0:1 / 7.7:1. On the iPhone (402x874, Dawn) the same lines measure 4.3:1 (HP, amber Strained) and 4.1:1 (XP), still under 4.5:1.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-home-dawn-mac.png, crop shots/a11y-hci/n-home-dawn-xp-crop.png; pixel sampling (ink vs 80th percentile bg) XP 3.21, HP 3.02, track 1.15; colours oklch(0.505 0.014 65) and oklch(0.485 0.1 195) at 12px; css/tokens.css:1375 (--art-scrim-l stops 0.82→0.32 at 34-64%); shots/a11y-hci/n-home-dawn-iphone.png (HP 4.33, XP 4.06 sampled)
findings.fix: Hold the scrim at >=0.85 under the text column in Dawn (a Dawn-specific --art-scrim-l), or give the meta line a glass backing; darken the XP track in Dawn.
findings.rootCause: The scrim was tuned for the dark ground; the Dawn art is light, so the muted roles lose contrast over it.

findings.title: No dialog closes on navigation: the router leaves every open dialog, drawer and sheet over the next page
findings.detail: KOS.ui.openDialog keeps a dialog stack but neither router.js nor KOS.show ever closes it, so any navigation while a dialog is open (browser Back/Forward, the iPad edge-swipe, a hash link, Backspace, a notification click, KOS.show from a timer) draws the new page under the old dialog, with the scroll lock still set. Reproduced: opened the picture drawer on Home (KOS.artSlot.open), then changed location.hash through #/files, #/reminders, #/calendar, #/goals, #/help and #/assistant: the Home hero drawer was still open over the Assistant (one .k-dialog-overlay, data-scroll-lock set). Several areas report the per-surface symptom (Creatives work dialog, Mind sheets, Money phone sheet, Badge set dialog, Backspace under a dialog); this is the shared root cause.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-asst-ipadl.png (Home's hero drawer over the Assistant at 1180x820); eval: .k-dialog-overlay count 1, data-scroll-lock present after 7 hash changes; js/core/ui.js:155-240 (openDialog/dialogStack, no navigation hook); js/core/router.js (no dialog handling)
findings.fix: In the router's navigation path (before rendering a different view, not on KOS.rerender), close every dialog on the stack via its own close path (teardown runs onClose), or let a dialog opt in to staying ({keepOnNav}).
findings.rootCause: Dialog lifetime is not tied to the route; each surface assumed the user leaves only via its own buttons.

findings.title: Light shop themes keep the dark-ground red: overdue day dots on Home fall to 1.3:1 in Washi Morning
findings.detail: Atelier Dawn restates the tokens bound to a dark ground (e.g. --red-soft, css/themes.css:119), but the light shop themes added in the art-and-shop release (Washi Morning; the same light ground is used by others such as First Snow) do not, so every status painted in --red-soft keeps the dark theme's light pink. Measured with Washi Morning on: Home's Upcoming overdue day dots ("5", "3") are oklch(0.8 0.08 22) on a 30% red wash over the light card = 1.32:1 (near invisible, see screenshot); the overdue meta "Sat 31 Oct" / "3 overdue" 3.23:1. In Dawn the same dot is 3.42:1. About 24 rules across components, home, study, collection, money, archive and productivity read --red-soft for status.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-home-washi-mac.png (Upcoming dots 5 and 3); scan lowc k-days-dot 5 1.32 @14px, k-check-row-meta 3.23, k-card-meta 3 overdue 3.23; eval colour oklch(0.8 0.0799 22) on oklch(0.66 0.17 22 / 0.3); css/components.css:194 (.k-days-dot[data-state~=late] color var(--red-soft)); css/tokens.css:1268 (--red-soft = l + 0.14); css/themes.css:119 (Dawn restates) vs :850 (washi-morning block, no restatement)
findings.fix: Paint status text in the alarm role tokens (--alarm-ink / a contrast-checked --alarm-text) rather than --red-soft, and give every light theme the same paper restatements as Dawn (a shared [data-ground=light] block); add a contrast check per theme to the theme test.
findings.rootCause: Invariant 26a assumes only Dawn is light; light shop themes inherit dark-ground derived tokens.

findings.title: No haptic or tactile-equivalent feedback anywhere on iPhone/iPad
findings.detail: Nothing in the app calls navigator.vibrate or offers any haptic substitute. On the user's touch devices the moments that would warrant one — a Focus cycle ending, the idle-watch warning, a flashcard rating, a routine completing, an unlock — rely on sound (silent on iOS, see the chime finding) or a short toast. iOS Safari does not support navigator.vibrate, so the practical substitute is a stronger, longer-lived visual cue plus a device notification for timer events while the page is hidden.
findings.evidence: grep -rn vibrate js css sw.js → no matches | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): grep navigator.vibrate across js/: no hits on this build; the Badge unlock overlay and Buy add none.
findings.fix: Add navigator.vibrate guarded calls for Android/desktop PWAs and, for iOS, make timer events post a local notification (already have the notify path) and keep the cue on screen until acknowledged.
findings.rootCause: No feedback-channel policy beyond toasts.

findings.title: Error toasts show raw exception text ('Save failed: <err.message>')
findings.detail: Ten error toasts concatenate err.message directly (IndexedDB/DOMException or fetch messages such as 'QuotaExceededError' text or 'Failed to fetch'), with no explanation or next step; elsewhere the app uses calm sentences ('Couldn't save it on this device.'). Wording is also split between 'Couldn't' and 'Could not' across 16+ toasts.
findings.evidence: js/modules/medview.js:594,1031,1049,1245; js/core/files.js:310; js/modules/files.js:108; js/modules/assignments.js:271; js/modules/governor-ui.js:876; js/modules/attachments.js:707,993 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Still ~52 toast sites concatenating err.message; the release added three more: js/modules/governor-ui.js:229 ('Banner upload failed: ' + err.message), :749 ('That picture could not be used: ' + err.message), :1332 ('Upload failed: ' + err.message).
findings.fix: Route errors through one helper (KOS.ui.failToast(action, err)) mapping known errors (quota, offline, permission) to a plain sentence with a next step; log the raw message to the console only. Pick one contraction style.
findings.rootCause: No shared error-message helper.

findings.title: Danger and gold buttons in Atelier Dawn fall to ~3:1 contrast
findings.detail: In Dawn, 'Reset everything…' (.k-btn--danger: text oklch(0.525 0.126 25) on a 30% red wash) measures 3.14:1, and the Shrine's 'Create share card' (.k-shr-gold: dark text oklch(0.2 0.03 70) on gold oklch(0.505 0.11 85)) 3.06:1, both 13px semibold (needs 4.5:1). The Shrine's '◆ Rank 03' label on its card measures 1.98:1.
findings.evidence: a11y-mac-dawn2.jsonl (data, shrine); computed styles via eval; shots/a11y-hci/shrine-dawn-real-mac.png (Rank 03 in orange on beige) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): changed: the danger button still measures 3.14:1 in Dawn (oklch(0.525 0.126 25) on a 30% red wash, css/components.css:156); the Gold Shop's redrawn gold Buy (.k-gv-buy) now measures 5.79:1, so only the danger half and the older gold surfaces remain
findings.fix: In Dawn's block, give --gold a light ink (crimson-ink style) for .k-shr-gold, deepen the danger button's text (l − 0.1) or use a solid --alarm fill with --crimson-ink text; rank labels use the medal's -ink variant.
findings.rootCause: Dawn restates role colours but not the button inks derived from them.
findings.recheck: changed: the danger button still measures 3.14:1 in Dawn (oklch(0.525 0.126 25) on a 30% red wash, css/components.css:156); the Gold Shop's redrawn gold Buy (.k-gv-buy) now measures 5.79:1, so only the danger half and the older gold surfaces remain

findings.title: Some text fields show no usable focus indicator
findings.detail: Several inputs remove the outline and replace it with a hairline in --line (1.2:1 against --s1 in Graphite) or nothing: Reminders' quick-add field (the only change is box-shadow inset hairline var(--line)), Routines' add-a-step and step inputs (.k-rt-add-in has no focus rule beyond outline:none on .k-rt-add-in:focus; .k-rt-step-in:focus uses a --line underline), the Assistant composer (hairline in --bloom-lo), Exams' result row (.k-exr:focus outline none). Programmatic focus test: Reminders' quick-add computed style is identical focused and unfocused.
findings.evidence: css/views/productivity.css:299,303; css/views/routines.css:88-90,228; css/views/assistant.css:215,217; css/views/exams.css:503; focus test script audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-focus.js (reminders: k-rem-quick-in no indicator) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Reminders quick-add (.k-rem-quick-in) on this build: outline none and box-shadow none before and after focus (:focus-visible matched); only its parent shows a 1px hairline; the header search input likewise on every page scanned.
findings.fix: Use the shared ring on the container: .k-rem-quick:focus-within, .k-rt-add:focus-within, .k-asst-composer:focus-within { outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--focus-ring) } as .k-search and .k-amount-field already do.
findings.rootCause: Per-view focus overrides instead of the shared :focus-within ring.

findings.title: Calendar dialogs float their Cancel/Close button in the middle of the footer
findings.detail: In the New event modal the footer shows Cancel centred (x 643-717 of a 303-1167 footer) and Add event at the right, unlike every other dialog (Cancel beside the primary, or Delete at the far left). Cause: the button carries .k-spacer (margin-inline-start:auto) and, being the footer's first child, also gets .k-dialog-foot > :first-child { margin-inline-end:auto }, so both margins are auto and it centres.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/backspace-under-dialog-mac.png (footer); eval margins ml=340.297px mr=340.297px; js/modules/calendar.js:1446 (Cancel with k-spacer), also :977, :1070, :1094 (Close with k-spacer); css/layout.css:358; css/components.css:374 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): New event dialog at 1470x832: Cancel margins 340.297px / 340.297px; js/modules/calendar.js:1446 (k-spacer on Cancel).
findings.fix: Drop .k-spacer from dialog footer buttons (the footer rule already places the first child) or scope .k-dialog-foot > :first-child to :not(.k-spacer).
findings.rootCause: Two layout rules from different layers both push one element.

findings.title: Reduced motion is not honoured by JS smooth scrolling
findings.detail: base.css forces scroll-behavior:auto under prefers-reduced-motion, but that only affects CSS-driven scrolling. Twelve call sites pass behavior:'smooth' explicitly to scrollIntoView/scrollBy/scrollTo, which the browser animates regardless: every topic page turn in CS/Maths/IT, Code, Japanese, Mind and Creatives lessons (the article scrolls to its top), the shared scroller's arrow paging, the phone section strip, the Exams guide's section jump, the ink tab and the long report pages. Only the Assistant, report story, Japanese/Mind scenes and Exam Room check the media query themselves (each with its own copy of the helper).
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:693; js/modules/hub.js:2874,2996; js/modules/codetopic.js:296,382; js/modules/jatopic.js:234; js/modules/mindtopic.js:292; js/modules/crtopic.js:176; js/modules/inktab.js:204; js/modules/examguide.js:109; js/modules/reportlong.js:441; js/modules/mobile-shell.js:120; css/base.css:163-169; duplicated reduced() helpers js/core/jaui.js:28, js/core/mindui.js:25, js/modules/assistant.js:250, js/modules/reportstory.js:474, js/modules/examroom.js:88 | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): 12 behavior:'smooth' calls (hub.js:2889, codetopic.js:296/382, reportlong.js:441, examguide.js:109, ui.js:759, mobile-shell.js:120 …) none gated on prefers-reduced-motion. (The new Badge unlock overlay does honour it: data-reduce, achievements.css:260.)
findings.fix: Add KOS.ui.reducedMotion() and KOS.ui.scrollBehavior() ('auto' when reduced) in ui.js; replace the literal 'smooth' and the five private helpers with it.
findings.rootCause: No shared motion helper; CSS reset cannot reach explicit JS behaviour.

findings.title: iPhone Assignments shows its title twice (phone title bar plus the page's own header)
findings.detail: On the phone the shell inserts a title bar with its own h1 and hides the page's .k-pagehead text, but only when the header is a DIRECT child of #main. Assignments renders its page header inside .k-asg-col, so both stay: 'STUDY Assignments ▾' and below it 'THE WORK QUEUE Assignments', two visible h1s and ~60px of repeated header above the filters.
findings.evidence: shots/resp/402x874-atelier-dawn-assignments.jpg (seen in shots/a11y-hci/sheets/iphone1.jpg); eval at 402x874: h1=['Assignments','Assignments']; parent chain k-pagehead → k-asg-col; css/components.css:643-646 (#main[data-phone-title] > .k-pagehead … child combinator) | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): eval at 402x874: visible h1 = ['Assignments','Assignments'].
findings.fix: Hide by a hook instead of position: #main[data-phone-title] [data-ui~='ui.page-head'] > .k-pagehead-txt { display:none } (and the same for the actions rule), or have Assignments mark its header data-phone-hide.
findings.rootCause: Child-combinator selector assumes every page header sits directly in #main.

findings.title: Inconsistent button wording: two plus glyphs, an empty state naming a button that does not exist
findings.detail: Add buttons use the full-width '＋' in some places ('＋ New assignment', '＋ New routine', '＋ New list' in Reminders, '＋ Log a result') and ASCII '+' in others ('+ New event', '+ Add item', '+ Add release', '+ Week', '+ Add row', '+ Capture', '+ New list' in vaults), with visibly different sizes and baselines; Reminders shows both on one screen. Exams & Papers' empty state says 'Use “+ Log entry” after your next assessment' while the button beside it reads '＋ Log a result'. Error toasts mix 'Couldn't' and 'Could not'.
findings.evidence: js/modules/tracker.js:421 ('+ Log entry') vs js/modules/exams.js:297 ('＋ Log a result'); empty-account label dump audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/a11y-empty-mac.txt (reminders: '＋' and '+'); grep text: "＋ …" (16 sites) vs "+ …" (30 sites); shots/a11y-hci/empty-tracker-mac.png | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Still mixed: 39 '＋ ' labels in js/modules vs '+ ' elsewhere (e.g. Calendar '+ New event', Money '+ Add entry', Seat '＋ Set a motto for your seat').
findings.fix: Pick one glyph (or an icon component) via a KOS.ui.addBtn(label) helper; fix the tracker empty-state text to name 'Log a result'.
findings.rootCause: Labels written ad hoc per module; no shared add-button helper.

findings.title: Tab strips declare role=tablist/tab but ignore arrow keys and have no tabpanel
findings.detail: KOS.ui.tabs (workspace and card variants) and ~11 hand-made strips mark their buttons role='tab' with aria-selected, so VoiceOver announces 'tab, 1 of 5' and the ARIA pattern promises Left/Right arrows. Nothing implements them: on Routines' strip, ArrowRight on the selected tab leaves focus on 'Today'; every tab stays tabindex 0 (no roving focus), and no tab has aria-controls / no region has role=tabpanel. Keyboard users must Tab through every tab, and screen-reader users are told to use keys that do nothing.
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:495 (role tab, aria-selected), :515 (role tablist); no Arrow handling in js/core/ui.js tabs or js/core/a11y.js; eval on #/routines: ArrowRight → focus stays 'Today', tabindexes [0,0,0,0,0], aria-controls all null; other role=tablist sites: js/engines/flashcards.js, js/modules/assistant.js, medview.js, code.js, dayreview.js, hub.js, coderider.js, codetopic.js, codecap.js, governor-ui.js, js/labs/oop.js | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): 31 role tab/tablist sites, 4 tabpanels; ui.js arrow handling only in the scroller (ui.js:763). The Wall's Sets/Recent/Showcase/Titles strip is the same primitive.
findings.fix: Either drop role=tab/tablist (these switch views, so plain buttons with aria-pressed or aria-current fit) or implement the pattern once in KOS.ui.tabs: roving tabindex, Left/Right/Home/End, aria-controls to the panel the page renders.
findings.rootCause: ARIA roles added without the keyboard behaviour they imply; hand-made strips copy the roles.

findings.title: iPad Calendar: every day cell carries an invisible '+' (New event) that a tap can hit
findings.detail: The month grid's per-day '+' (.k-cal-add, aria-label 'New event on <day>') is opacity 0 until :hover or :focus-visible. Unlike Reminders' delete, Pacing's move and the topic's row buttons, it has no (hover: none) override, so on the iPad (touch, no hover, wider than the phone tier where it is display:none) it is never visible yet stays a live 24x24 target in each cell's top-right corner: the feature cannot be discovered, and a tap aimed at the cell's date lands on an invisible button and opens the New event dialog.
findings.evidence: css/views/productivity.css:470-471 (opacity 0; shown on .k-cal-cell:hover / :focus-visible), :890 (phone: display none), :961-963 (hover:none block lists .k-rem-del, .k-hb-del, .k-pace-move only); eval at 820x1180 touch: matchMedia('(hover: none)') true, .k-cal-add opacity '0', label 'New event on Mon 26 Oct' | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Scan at 820x1180 touch: k-cal-add '+' drawn at 1.00:1 (opacity 0) in every cell.
findings.fix: Add .k-cal-add to the productivity.css hover:none block (opacity 1, muted) or remove it on touch and rely on the header's '+ New event' with the tapped day preselected.
findings.rootCause: Hover-reveal pattern applied without the touch override used elsewhere.

findings.title: Goals opens on a blank page (no loading state) until the async compute returns
findings.detail: KOS.views.goals draws the header, appends an empty .k-gl container and fills it only in G.compute's callback (which reads the Collection vault for the Collection goal types). On the seeded account at iPad size the container was 0px high with no children for 0.8-1.2s after navigation (2.5s+ on a cold load: the responsive audit's iPad screenshot captured an empty Goals page). Nothing says it is loading, so the page reads as 'no goals' — the opposite of the truth (9 goals).
findings.evidence: js/modules/goals.js:306-309 (empty page then G.compute(callback)); eval sampling every 400ms after KOS.show('goals') at 820x1180: ['0/0','0/0','1085/3',…]; shots/a11y-hci/goals-ipad.png (blank, 2.5s after navigation) vs shots/a11y-hci/goals-ipad2.png (filled); shots/resp/820x1180-atelier-dawn-goals.jpg blank | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): changed: the blank is now short — seeded, #/goals had only the header (118-136 characters of text) at 300 ms and was filled (847) by 600 ms on both 820x1180 and 402x874, versus ~2.5 s before; still no loading state (js/modules/goals.js:306-309)
findings.fix: Render skeleton cards (or the last computed rows from a memo) synchronously and replace them in the callback; set aria-busy on the container meanwhile.
findings.rootCause: Async compute with no placeholder.
findings.recheck: changed: the blank is now short — seeded, #/goals had only the header (118-136 characters of text) at 300 ms and was filled (847) by 600 ms on both 820x1180 and 402x874, versus ~2.5 s before; still no loading state (js/modules/goals.js:306-309)

findings.title: Help & Guide describes screens that no longer exist, and its last section has no mark
findings.detail: The guide is where invariant 50a sends every rule the pages stop re-teaching, but entries are stale: 'Overview' (the first thing a reader opens) describes the old Home — 'overall completion ring … flagged topics … Click a subject card to open its dashboard' — Home has no subject cards; 'Planner' says 'The Planner workspace holds Budget Planner and Goals under one secondary tab bar', a switch removed when Goals moved to Productivity and the Planner became the Wishlist (invariant 27); 'Notifications' still says 'Budget Planner item'. The shortcut card omits Backspace-as-Back (see the Backspace finding). The eighth section, 'Data & housekeeping', shows a '·' where every other section has a kanji, because SECTION_MARK has seven entries for eight sections.
findings.evidence: js/modules/help.js:11 (Overview text), :79 (Planner), :78 (Budget Planner), :144 (SECTION_MARK, 7 marks), :255 (fallback '·'); shots/a11y-hci/help-mac.png | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): js/modules/help.js:79 still describes 'The Planner workspace holds Budget Planner and Goals'; SECTION_MARK has 7 marks for 8 sections (eval: the 8th renders '·').
findings.fix: Rewrite Overview/Planner/Notifications against today's Home, Wishlist and Goals; add an eighth mark (e.g. 管) to SECTION_MARK; add a smoke check that every Help 'Open <page>' target and named route still exists.
findings.rootCause: Help text is hand-maintained and not checked against the shipped views.

findings.title: Calendar's leading/trailing days fade their events to ~2.3-2.9:1 while they stay clickable
findings.detail: Cells from the previous/next month put their event stack at opacity 0.4 (0.75 on hover/focus-within). Event chips there are still full buttons (they open the event), but their 11px titles measure 2.87:1 in Graphite and 2.28:1 in Dawn, and the day number 1.2-1.45:1. On the iPad there is no hover to raise them. A week that straddles months (e.g. 26 Oct-1 Nov on the November grid) shows half its week this way.
findings.evidence: eval on #/calendar: first cal.ev-t 'Revision block 28' 2.87 (Graphite) / 2.28 (Dawn) with ancestor k-cal-stack opacity 0.4; css/views/productivity.css:465 (other-month stack 0.75 on hover/focus-within); scan a11y-mac.jsonl, a11y-mac-dawn2.jsonl | Re-check 6 Nov 2026 (kos-redraw-1): Seeded, this build, both 1470x832 and 820x1180: cal.ev-t 2.87:1 @11px, cal.more '+2 more' 1.82:1, cal.daynum 1.20:1 in the faded cells.
findings.fix: Dim the day number and cell ground instead of the events (e.g. date in --muted, events at full contrast with a muted dot), or keep opacity ≥ 0.7 so text stays ≥ 4.5:1.
findings.rootCause: Opacity applied to the whole stack including interactive text.

findings.title: The Wall says 'Owned 8 / 254' while its Earned filter and the showcase picker list 21 earned badges
findings.detail: Seeded account: the Wall's toolbar and the Seat's glass card print 'Owned 8 / 254' (counts() counts a badge only once its LAST tier is earned), but the Wall's 'Earned' filter shows every badge with tier > 0 (21) and Edit your seat's Showcase tab says 'Earned · 21, newest first'. Three surfaces use two meanings of earned/owned for the same badges with no explanation, so a user who has 21 medals lit sees '8'.
findings.evidence: eval: KOS.achievements.counts() = {owned: 8, badges: 254, tiers: 44}; list() badges with tier>0 = 21; js/core/achievements.js:343-351 (owned only when e.tier >= d.tiers.length); js/modules/achievements.js:148 (filter earned = v.tier > 0), :176 ('Owned'); js/modules/governor-ui.js:384; shots/a11y-hci/t-wall-mac.png, t-edit-mac.png
findings.fix: Pick one word per meaning: 'Earned 21 · 8 complete' (or 'Badges earned 21 / 254 · tiers 44 / 417') on the Wall and the Seat, and keep 'Earned' for tier > 0 everywhere.
findings.rootCause: counts().owned means 'fully earned' but is labelled with the same word the filter uses for 'any tier'.

findings.title: Shop actions (Try on, Use, Take off, Buy) drop keyboard focus to the page and announce nothing for Try on
findings.detail: Each ware action calls render(), which empties the panel and rebuilds every card, so the pressed button is destroyed and focus falls to MAIN/BODY; a keyboard or Switch Control user must tab from the top again after every Try on. Try on also announces nothing (the theme changes silently), while Buy does announce.
findings.evidence: eval on #/governor/shop: focus 'Try on Winter', click → document.activeElement BODY (mac) / MAIN (ipad); scroll position kept (card foot 598 → 590 px); js/modules/governor-ui.js:1041 (Try on → tryItem + render()), :212-218 (render empties panel), :1052-1056 (Use / Take off → render())
findings.fix: After render(), refocus the same control by data-ui + item id (or update the card in place), and announce 'Trying on X — leave the shop to stop' through KOS.a11y.announce.
findings.rootCause: Whole-panel re-render as the update path.

findings.title: Badge dialog lays a four-tier badge out 3 + 1, leaving the fourth medal alone on a second row
findings.detail: In the 760px set dialog a badge with four tiers (Focus · In the zone: 10/100/500/1,000 sessions) shows three medals in a row and the fourth centred alone underneath, with empty space either side, although four 120px medals fit in one row of the 640px stage.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/t-setdlg-over-money-mac.png (IV · 1,000 sessions alone on row two); js/modules/achievements.js:547 (tiers list, data-n); css/views/achievements.css .k-ach-dlg-tiers
findings.fix: Lay tiers by count: 4 in one row (or 2x2), 5 as 3+2 centred; drive the column count from data-n.
findings.rootCause: A fixed 3-column grid for every tier count.

findings.title: Search cannot find a badge, a title, the Gold Shop or any page by name
findings.detail: KOS.search.run covers spec, notes, reminders, assignments, calendar, planner, goals, cards, media, reports and files only. Typing 'Bookworm' (an earned title), 'Gold Shop' or a badge name returns nothing; 'badge' and 'Wall' return unrelated specification hits. In a one-OS app with ~60 pages and a Wall of 254 badges, the header search is the natural way to reach 'the shop' or 'Pen and ink'.
findings.evidence: eval KOS.search.run: 'Bookworm' → [], 'Gold Shop' → [], 'badge' → [spec F206.3.2], 'Wall' → [spec 4.9.3.2]; js/core/search.js:65-288 (domain list), grep achiev|badge js/core/search.js → 0
findings.fix: Add a Pages domain (view titles, tabs and settings pages from the route table) and an Achievements domain (badge and title names → #/achievements/set/<id>/<badge>, once the router encodes it).
findings.rootCause: Search domains were added per data store; navigation and the newer domains were never registered.

findings.title: The Seat's 'First day' reads the state document's creation date, not your first record
findings.detail: The Wall glass on the Seat prints 'Days journeyed 138 days' (from the ledger rollup) beside 'First day 5 Nov 2026' (today) on the seeded account, because First day is +store.state.created. Any account whose history predates its state document (sessions imported, a device restored without `created`, the review namespace) shows a first day after 138 days of journey.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/t-seat-mac.png, t-seat-ipad.png; js/modules/governor-ui.js:378 (since = +store.state.created), :390-391
findings.fix: First day = min(state.created, the ledger's first entry, the rollup's first month).
findings.rootCause: Two sources for one fact.

findings.title: Help & Guide says nothing about the Wall, titles, Try on or 'Your own picture', and still says gold buys only unlocks and cosmetics
findings.detail: help.js has no entry for Achievements/the Badge Wall, titles, the showcase, Edit your seat, Try on or the picture drawer; its Gold entry says gold is spent 'on permanent lab/sim unlocks and cosmetics', which no longer covers the 'Your own picture' upload unlocks (invariant 2 since 5.14). The Seat's own header still calls it 'Your identity, current access state…' although HP gates nothing.
findings.evidence: grep -c 'Badge|achiev' js/modules/help.js → 0; js/modules/help.js:61 (Gold), :127 ('Open Gold Shop'); js/modules/governor-ui.js:50 ('current access state'); shots/a11y-hci/t-seat-mac.png
findings.fix: Add Help entries for the Wall (sets, tiers, titles, showcase), the Seat and Edit your seat, Try on, and the picture drawer; reword Gold and the Seat sub-line ('…your state, study rhythm and what you have earned').
findings.rootCause: Help is hand-written and was not part of the release checklist for 5.13-5.17.

findings.title: Showcase and Seat saves are spoken twice (toast plus a second announce)
findings.detail: KOS.ui.toast already sends its message through KOS.a11y.announce (ui.js toast), and announce deliberately re-announces an identical sentence; three call sites then announce the same words again, so VoiceOver reads 'Showcase saved. Showcase saved.', 'Seat saved. Seat saved.' and 'Six at most — remove one first.' twice.
findings.evidence: js/core/ui.js:72-87 (toast -> KOS.a11y.announce(msg)); js/modules/achievements.js:397, :413; js/modules/governor-ui.js:814
findings.fix: Drop the extra KOS.a11y.announce calls next to toast(), or add a {silent} option to toast for callers that announce a longer sentence.
findings.rootCause: Callers unaware toast already announces.

findings.title: The picture drawer's Rotate thumbnails are buttons that do nothing
findings.detail: In the picture drawer (KOS.artSlot, opened from Home's hero chip and the Wardrobe), Rotate → By time draws the slot's pictures as <button aria-pressed> thumbnails, but they are created with onClick null. Clicking or pressing Enter on one changes nothing and gives no feedback; a keyboard/VoiceOver user tabs through four 'toggle buttons' that cannot be toggled. Reproduced: Rotate tab, click Winter → state.artSlots.home unchanged ({mode:'rotate',period:'season'}).
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-drawer-rotate-mac.png; eval: afterThumbClick cfg unchanged; js/modules/artslot.js:31-34 (thumb() is always a button) and :61 (thumb(p, A.pick(slot)===p.id, null))
findings.fix: In Rotate mode render the thumbnails as non-interactive figures (a <ul> of images with the current one marked aria-current), or make a click switch to One picture with that pick.
findings.rootCause: thumb() always builds a <button> regardless of whether an action is passed.

findings.title: iPhone Gold Shop truncates item names that would fit ('The night tr…')
findings.detail: At 402px the shop deals wares two to a row (177px cards) and puts the name and the price on one line, so names are cut with an ellipsis: 'The night train' (97px needed, 88px given), 'Starfall Serenade', 'Feathered Dusk'. The name is the thing being bought; the price could wrap under it.
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-shop-iphone2.png; scan a11y21-iphone.jsonl clipped k-gv-ware-name x3; eval scrollWidth 97 / clientWidth 88 at 14px
findings.fix: Under 560px stack name over price in .k-gv-ware head (flex-wrap or column), or allow two lines for the name.
findings.rootCause: One-line name+price row with ellipsis in a narrow two-column grid.

findings.title: Files' empty state fades its live filter bar to 55% (text ~3.6:1)
findings.detail: With no files, .k-files[data-state~=empty] .k-files-bar is set to opacity 0.55, but its search box, 'Has my writing' checkbox and Grid/List switch stay enabled and focusable. Faded, 'Has my writing' measures 3.62:1 and 'Grid' 4.10:1 in Graphite (AA 4.5). A control that works should not look disabled; one that does nothing should be disabled.
findings.evidence: scan a11y21-mac/iphone.jsonl lowc 'Has my writing' 3.62 @13px, 'Grid' 4.10; eval opacity product 0.55, input not disabled; css/views/archive.css:284; js/modules/files.js:177-184
findings.fix: Either disable the bar's controls in the empty state (and say so), or drop the fade.
findings.rootCause: Visual de-emphasis via opacity on interactive controls.

findings.title: Assistant: Hide / Show Kurenai and Voice redraw the whole page and drop focus; the chips are 21px tall on the iPad
findings.detail: Hide, Show Kurenai and the Voice chip each call KOS.show("assistant", ...) to redraw, so keyboard focus falls to <body> (measured activeElement BODY after Hide and after Show) and the user must tab back from the top. The Voice chip names its state in its label AND in aria-pressed, so VoiceOver reads "Voice off, toggle button, not pressed" (a double negative). On the iPad in landscape (touch) the Pin, Hide and Voice chips are 45x21, 42x21 and 66x21 px, under the 44px floor.
findings.evidence: eval at 1180x820 touch: chips [[◇ Pin,45,21],[Hide,42,21],[Voice off,66,21]]; activeElement BODY after Hide/Show; js/modules/assistant.js:2039-2061 (setHidden -> KOS.show; Voice text + aria-pressed)
findings.fix: Toggle the presence panel in place (data-state) or restore focus to the counterpart chip after the redraw; give Voice a fixed label ("Voice") with aria-pressed; raise .k-asst-chip-btn to the touch minimum under pointer:coarse.
findings.rootCause: Full-view redraw for a local toggle; chip class not covered by the touch floor.

findings.title: iPhone: Edit your seat's preview is the desktop Stage shrunk to 28% (4.5px text)
findings.detail: Edit your seat draws a live preview by rendering the 1328px-wide Stage and scaling it (transform: scale(var(--prev-s))). At 402px the scale is 0.279, so the preview's text is 4.5px tall and its showcase slots are dots; the preview is a picture of a page you cannot read, and it is not how the Seat looks on the phone (the phone Seat is a single column). The Save button is also shown as the primary action on first open with nothing changed (empty account).
findings.evidence: shots/a11y-hci/n-edit-empty-iphone.png; eval at 402x874: .k-gv-prev-inner transform matrix(0.278614…), smallest text box 4.46px; css/views/governor.css:150-151; js/modules/governor-ui.js:655-673
findings.fix: Under 700px preview the phone composition at 1:1 (or only the parts being edited: banner, title, sigil, showcase tray), and keep Save disabled until something changes.
findings.rootCause: The preview is a scaled desktop render regardless of the device.
